name: Crimson Hexagon
tagline: Crimson Hexagon (now Brandwatch Consumer Research) is an AI-powered consumer intelligence platform that analyses social media, news, and review data at massive scale. Its natural-language processing identifies themes, sentiment shifts, and demographic patterns in unstructured text. Brand teams and market researchers use it to understand consumer perception and track campaign impact in real time.
